mapper.sql: id, user_id, type, change_amount, balance_after, remain_amount, expire_time, batch_tx_id, description, ref_id, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_transaction (user_id, type, change_amount, balance_after, remain_amount, expire_time, batch_tx_id, description, ref_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{changeAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{remainAmount}, #{expireTime}, #{batchTxId}, #{description}, #{refId})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM point_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND remain_amount > 0 AND expire_time > NOW() ORDER BY expire_time, id FOR UPDATE

SELECT
FROM point_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT
FROM point_transaction WHERE ref_id = #{refId} AND type = 'APPOINTMENT_CONSUME' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE point_transaction SET deleted = 1 WHERE ref_id = #{refId} AND type = 'APPOINTMENT_CONSUME' AND deleted = 0
